purpose: Commit 155dc6c moved gen12_eu_pred/ and gen12_2_eu_pred/ from the repository root into generations/. Their manifests (manifests/manifest.json, key 'artefacts') hash nearly every file in those directories, code included. These entries record, as exact text substitutions, the only edits made to manifest-listed files so that the code resolves the same targets after the move. generations/verify_relocation.py undoes the substitutions and checks the result against the hashes read live from the manifests, so the frozen manifests stay verifiable without being rewritten. Hashes are deliberately not stored here.

entries.reason: REPO_ROOT was GEN12_ROOT.parent, which was the repository root while gen12_eu_pred/ sat at the root; after the move it is generations/, so src/ on sys.path, the frozen bundle in 'dataset with 3D structures/', the runs/ caches and dataset_all_metals/ all resolved under generations/ and did not exist. One more .parent makes REPO_ROOT the repository root again; every path derived from it is then byte-for-byte the pre-move target.

REPO_ROOT was GEN122_ROOT.parent, i.e. generations/ after the move. It gains one .parent so it names the repository root again, and GEN12_ROOT, which is derived from it, gains generations/ so it still names gen12_eu_pred/ (the sys.path entry for gen12eu and every frozen Gen12 artefact Gen12.2 reads).

import importlib.util  # noqa: E402
_RELOCATION_SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
    "verify_relocation", paths.REPO_ROOT / "generations" / "verify_relocation.py")
verify_relocation = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_RELOCATION_SPEC)
_RELOCATION_SPEC.loader.exec_module(verify_relocation)

entries.reason: 'gen12_manifest.py --verify' compares every Gen12 artefact byte-for-byte with Gen12's manifest, and gen12eu/paths.py now carries a recorded relocation edit, so after the move it reported a false 'DRIFT: artefact changed: gen12eu/paths.py' and exited 1. The --verify branch loads generations/verify_relocation.py by file location and hashes original_bytes(path), which undoes only the substitutions recorded here, so any other change is still drift. Stamping (collect) still hashes the bytes on disk.
